items.title: Cybersecurity aur mehfooz digital ishtirak: ta'aruf (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to cybersecurity and safe digital collaboration (PDF 122).

blocks.text: Yeh chapter dekhta hai ke technology digital duniya mein mehfooz, mehfooz-tar aur zimmedarana shirakat ko kaise sahara deti hai. Is mein online hifazat, cybersecurity, data ki hifazat, privacy settings aur jadeed platforms par mehfooz ishtirak; digital karobar (entrepreneurship), jiddat aur karobari mauqe pehchanne ki maharatein; aur computing ke akhlaqi, qanooni, samaji aur mahoolyati pehlu, jaise intellectual property, data ki raazdari, cybersecurity ke qawaneen aur paidar computing shamil hain. Yeh zaati, taleemi aur peshawarana zindagi mein team work, rasai (accessibility), digital rabte aur technology ke zimmedarana istemal par bhi zor deta hai (Fig 9.1).

blocks.title: Cybersecurity
blocks.text: Cybersecurity computers, networks, data aur online accounts ko be-ijazat rasai, ghalat istemal, nuqsan ya cyber hamlon se bachane ka amal hai.

blocks.alt: Darmiyani daira 'you, online' chaar dabbon se jura: security (devices, accounts aur data ki hifazat), privacy (jo share karein us par control), ethics aur teamwork (izzat-dar, imandar ishtirak) aur global connectivity (duniya bhar ke log aur khayalat). Note chapter ke mauzuat: mehfooz aadatein, cyber khatre aur difa, ishtirak, digital karobar, aur computing ke qawaneen aur asraat.
blocks.caption: Jure hue jahan mein cybersecurity, akhlaqiyat aur digital ishtirak (Fig 9.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Har online amal aik saath chaaron hisson ko chhoota hai: maslan group project post karna hifazat, raazdari, team work aur aise logon ko shamil karta hai jin se aap shayad kabhi na milein.

blocks.prompt: Teen cheezein batayein jo yeh chapter aap ko online mehfooz tareeqe se karna sikhayega.
blocks.explanation: Maslan: mazboot passwords aur two-factor authentication se accounts bachana; phishing jaise khatre pehchanna; Google Workspace jaise platforms par mehfooz ishtirak; aur technology ka qanooni aur akhlaqi istemal (koi teen).
